name: noise machine
source:
your girlfriend thinks the white noise machine she found and brought back for you might be broken—it doesn't sound like the white nose machine that her therapist uses—but you are enamored with this gift. you're getting the best sleep you've ever gotten in your life. it even talks to you! it's definitely not cursed or haunted or anything. awawa

[From [url=https://jammyjams.itch.io/noise-machine]itch.io[/url]]
